column7: 2026-11-05: Length validator (not yet written, sketch only): min/max must count UTF-8 bytes, not characters. Reason: these fields go into Oracle VARCHAR2(n BYTE) columns, and inserts failed on accented names that passed a len() check. So validate len(data.encode('utf-8')), and don't emit JSON-schema minLength/maxLength as if they were byte counts. The rest of the earlier sketch was approved: Use-style error placement, report length not data in the message, inclusive bounds.
